map.输入两端温差 ΔT₁、ΔT₂，求对数平均温差。: Enter the two end temperature differences ΔT1 and ΔT2 to get the log mean temperature difference.
map.换热器平均温差 LMTD=(ΔT1−ΔT2)/ln(ΔT1/ΔT2)。: Heat exchanger mean temperature difference LMTD = (ΔT1 − ΔT2)/ln(ΔT1/ΔT2).
